source: WNBA.com standings (2010 on) and the WNBA.com schedule feed (every season)
note: W-L and finish from wnba.com/standings when published (2010 on). Before 2010 the W-L is counted from final regular-season scores in the league schedule feed, and the finish is the conference rank from archived WNBA.com standings pages (Wayback Machine) for 1998, 2002-2004 and 2007-2009, or from Basketball-Reference for 1997, 1999-2001, 2005 and 2006, where no archived official table was found. Each row names its finish source.
